title: If energy cannot be created from nothing, where did it come from
description_first_300: Energy can't be created or destroyed. It's one of the most tested rules in physics, and no experiment has ever broken it. Yet the universe is full of energy: stars, galaxies, light, and matter itself. And as space expands, the oldest light in the universe loses energy while dark energy keeps growing
